name: io.github.orldev/snail-mcp-roslyn
description: MCP server that keeps a C# solution compiled and answers an agent faster than it loses the thread: diagnostics, symbols, references, refactoring plans and analyzers, decided by the compiler rather than text search.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_ROSLYN_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port to answer on over Streamable HTTP at /mcp, on every interface, each session naming its copy as /mcp?root=<path>; unset or 0, the server speaks stdio to the process that started it.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_ROSLYN_SESSION_ROOTS__0
environmentVariables.description: A folder this process may reach at all (…__1, …__2 for more); none means wherever it can, which is right for a server started for one caller and wrong for one shared by several.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_ROSLYN_RESTORE_ON_LOAD
environmentVariables.description: Whether load_solution restores packages itself when none are restored; off for a deployment that restores by other means.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_ROSLYN_RESTORE_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Seconds one restore may take; past it the load goes on unrestored and says so.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_ROSLYN_MAX_ISSUES
environmentVariables.description: The most diagnostics one answer lists.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_ROSLYN_MAX_FINDINGS
environmentVariables.description: The most analyzer and audit findings one answer lists.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_ROSLYN_MAX_RESPONSE_CHARS
environmentVariables.description: How large a single answer may be, serialised; a larger one is refused with its size rather than returned cut.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_ROSLYN_ALLOW_SCRIPTS
environmentVariables.description: Whether run_script may execute C# in this process; the container, or the absence of one, is the only boundary.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_ROSLYN_ANALYZER_POLICY
environmentVariables.description: Where analyzer assemblies may be loaded from: strict (the package cache and the .NET installation), default (plus the solution's own tree) or all.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_ROSLYN_MEMORY_ADVICE_MEGABYTES
environmentVariables.description: Working set past which health_check advises a restart: script and analyzer assemblies are never unloaded.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_ROSLYN_MAX_SOLUTIONS
environmentVariables.description: How many solutions stay loaded at once; the one used longest ago is dropped.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_ROSLYN_MAX_RUN_STEPS
environmentVariables.description: How many steps one run_tools call may take.
